title: RalliSport Challenge 2
subtitle: Rally takes several different roads

body: RalliSport Challenge 2 is Digital Illusions CE's Xbox racing game, released in North America on 4 May 2004. It expands the earlier RalliSport Challenge through a career that moves between rally stages, rallycross, hill climbs and other forms of competition. Snow, ice and night driving change the conditions around the car, while different event formats ask for different habits. A solitary run against the clock demands a clean line; a race with opponents adds the problem of sharing it. The sequel makes that variety the structure of its championship.

Damage can remove body panels and affect the way a car performs, turning an untidy corner into a problem that continues beyond the impact. Tuning options allow tyres, gearing and other settings to be adjusted for the conditions ahead. The player can therefore prepare for a surface as well as react to it. Career progress unlocks more cars and courses, while time attacks offer a simpler reason to return to a familiar stage. Better results come from understanding where a particular car has grip and where it needs restraint.

The game formed part of Microsoft's XSN Sports range, combining Xbox Live competition with online rankings and tournament features. System Link and local multiplayer offered other ways to race, with online sessions supporting larger groups than split-screen play. Reviewers praised the presentation, accessible handling and variety, making it one of the original Xbox's best-regarded racing games. The original Live service ended in 2010, but the single-player career retains the breadth of its design. Its changing surfaces and event types make the championship a continuing lesson in adapting to the road.
